name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention; 'blit_sheet_sprite_at_offset' accurately describes the behavior: resolve sprite #sprite_idx via the sprite-atlas sheet's offset table (sheet + 6 + idx*4) and blit it. No Ghidra address residue (no hex suffix). Verified against disasm at 0x1685c (ADD EDX,[EDX+EAX*4+6]) and caller fd2_draw_spell_selection_list which passes sprite 0x5C (MP icon) as sprite_idx.
purpose: Resolve sprite #sprite_idx in a sprite-atlas sheet via its 4-byte-per-entry offset table (base sheet+6) and paint it opaquely (raw header+pixel blit) at dst.
logic_summary: sprite_addr = sheet + *(int32*)(sheet + 6 + sprite_idx*4); then fd2_blit_sprite_raw_with_header(dst, sprite_addr, dst_pitch). The atlas offset table starts at sheet+6, 4 bytes per entry, giving the byte offset (relative to sheet) of each sprite's header (width word 0, height word 2, then width*height raw pixel bytes). Compiler-generated __CHK(0x14) stack probe at entry (omitted in C source per house pattern). Cyclomatic complexity 1, single basic block, 2 callees (__CHK, fd2_blit_sprite_raw_with_header).
signature: void fd2_blit_sheet_sprite_at_offset(uint32 dst, uint32 dst_pitch, uint32 sheet, uint32 sprite_idx)

params.name: dst
params.semantics: Destination base linear address where the resolved sprite is painted. Verified: caller passes a computed framebuffer/backbuffer address (e.g. blit_addr = col_addr_offset + 0x32 + row_y in fd2_draw_spell_selection_list).
params.reason: Accurate and address-residue-free. Note: in the raw Ghidra decompile the param names are jumbled (Ghidra maps this stack slot to param_1); the C source already declares the correct name 'dst'.

params.name: dst_pitch
params.semantics: Destination row stride in bytes, forwarded unchanged to fd2_blit_sprite_raw_with_header as its per-row dst advance. Verified: callers pass 0x140 (320, mode13h row width).
params.reason: Accurate and address-residue-free; matches the stride argument of the callee.

params.name: sheet
params.semantics: Sprite-atlas base linear address. Its 4-byte-per-entry offset table starts at sheet+6. Verified: caller passes data_fd2_ui_anim_sprite_sheet_ptr.
params.reason: Accurate and address-residue-free; consistent with sibling atlas-lookup functions in the same file.

params.name: sprite_idx
params.semantics: Index into the sheet's offset table selecting which sub-sprite to blit. Verified: caller passes literal 0x5C (the MP-cost icon) in fd2_draw_spell_selection_list.
params.reason: Accurate and address-residue-free. The disasm reads it as EAX scaled by *4 with +6 base, i.e. an offset-table index, exactly as the name says. (The Ghidra decompile mislabels this slot as 'dst' due to a known param-naming artifact, noted in the plate; the C source has the correct name.)

returns.semantics: No return value. (The decompiler shows a pass-through in_EAX artifact via the callee, but the binary leaves EAX as the callee left it and no caller consumes a result.)

comment_original_issue: Comment was accurate but (a) understated callers as '17x by fd2_assemble_dialog_frame_layered ... also called by other panel/grid renderers' without the 9-total breakdown, (b) omitted the compiler-generated __CHK(0x14) stack-probe note that sibling functions in this file document, and (c) used em-dash (U+2014) bullets in the Args list, violating the ASCII-only code-text rule.
notes: Verified caller arg order via fd2_draw_spell_selection_list @ 0x1ceed: call is fd2_blit_sheet_sprite_at_offset(blit_addr, 0x140, ui_anim_sprite_sheet, 0x5C) -> (dst, dst_pitch, sheet, sprite_idx), matching the C signature. Verified arithmetic via disasm @ 0x1685c: ADD EDX,[EDX+EAX*0x4+0x6] == sheet + *(int*)(sheet + 6 + sprite_idx*4).
